ir.name: pairwise_margin_with_bias_and_clip_normalized_v2_repair
ir.intuition: Repair clamp domain safety and normalize weighted loss robustly to avoid joint preference violation, preserving original margin nonlinear modulation and bias.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-8
lpw=batch['log_prob_w']
lpl=batch['log_prob_l']
weight=batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
delta_rank=batch['delta_rank']
abs_delta_rank_mean=mean(abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
alpha=0.8
gamma=extra.get('gamma', 2.0)
beta=0.04 * abs_delta_rank_mean
margin=lpw - lpl
linear_comb=alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank
scaled_margin=tanh(linear_comb)
bias_dynamic=gamma * beta * delta_rank
biased_margin=scaled_margin + bias_dynamic
x=clamp(biased_margin,-15,15)
loss_per_pair=-logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss=loss_per_pair * weight
norm=sum(weight) + eps
loss=sum(weighted_loss) / norm
return loss.mean() if needed else loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = 0.8
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
    beta = 0.04 * abs_delta_rank_mean

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    linear_comb = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    scaled_margin = ops.tanh(linear_comb)
    bias_dynamic = ops.mul(gamma * beta, delta_rank)
    biased_margin = ops.add(scaled_margin, bias_dynamic)
    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -15.0, 15.0)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)
    return loss
